name: Enterprise CISO
description: Chief Information Security Officers at mid-to-large enterprises seeking advanced threat detection and compliance automation to protect critical assets and meet regulatory requirements.
painPoints: Alert fatigue from too many false positives
Lack of unified visibility across hybrid environments

name: IT Director — Financial Services
description: IT Directors at banks, insurance companies, and fintech firms responsible for securing sensitive financial data and ensuring SOX/PCI-DSS compliance.
painPoints: Regulatory audit preparation is manual and slow
buyerRole: IT Director / Head of IT Security

name: Defense Contractor PM
description: Program Managers at defense contractors managing classified and CUI environments who need CMMC/NIST 800-171 compliance and supply chain security.
painPoints: Long procurement cycles for security tools

name: Critical Infrastructure Operator
description: Security leads at utilities, energy, and transportation organizations protecting OT/ICS environments from nation-state and ransomware threats.
painPoints: Legacy SCADA systems with no patching path
Real-time threat detection for industrial protocols
buyerRole: OT Security Manager / Plant Security Lead

name: MSSP / MDR Provider
description: Managed Security Service Providers seeking scalable, multi-tenant detection and response platforms to serve their customer base efficiently.
painPoints: Scaling SOC operations across hundreds of tenants
Reducing mean time to detect and respond

name: Healthcare Security Director
description: Security directors at hospitals and health systems protecting PHI and medical devices while maintaining HIPAA compliance and operational uptime.
painPoints: Ransomware targeting medical devices and EHR systems
HIPAA audit readiness and breach notification
Budget constraints vs expanding attack surface
